title: #286 Food Demand
prompt: The demand for food is increasing worldwide. What are the causes? What measures could the international community take to improve the situation?

promptSegments.text: The demand for food is increasing worldwide.
What measures could the international community take to improve the situation?

requirements.en: Identify the main problems or causes.
requirements.vi: Xác định các vấn đề hoặc nguyên nhân chính.
Đề xuất các giải pháp thực tế.

requirements.en: Explain why the solutions could work.
requirements.vi: Giải thích vì sao các giải pháp có thể hiệu quả.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of increasing food demand is the continuous growth of the world's population, which necessitates that farms produce significantly more food.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of increasing food demand is the continuous growth of the world's population, which necessitates that farms produce significantly more food.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: An effective solution is improving farming methods, such as using less water and better seeds, to boost food production on existing land.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: An effective solution is improving farming methods, such as using less water and better seeds, to boost food production on existing land.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main cause of rising food demand is population growth and changing lifestyles, which puts stress on existing food supplies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main cause of rising food demand is population growth and changing lifestyles, which puts stress on existing food supplies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution to improve the situation is enhancing global food distribution and infrastructure to reduce waste.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution to improve the situation is enhancing global food distribution and infrastructure to reduce waste.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of rising food demand is the combination of rapid population growth and changing consumption habits, which strains natural resources.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of rising food demand is the combination of rapid population growth and changing consumption habits, which strains natural resources.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A key solution to improve the situation is the global adoption of sustainable farming practices to enhance resource efficiency and maintain environmental balance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A key solution to improve the situation is the global adoption of sustainable farming practices to enhance resource efficiency and maintain environmental balance.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list solutions without connecting them to the stated problems.
promptTraps.vi: Không liệt kê giải pháp mà không liên hệ với các vấn đề đã nêu.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
